entities.name: Person A

entities.name: Object A
entities.identification: A brown cylindrical throwable with a blue-green band and yellow circular patterns around its middle, and a dark protruding structure on top.

entities.name: light-brown courtyard road

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: A dilapidated light blue-gray sedan beside the curb on the left, with a low-slung body and open window areas and rear side section.

entities.name: pile of bag-like bundles and light-colored wooden crates
entities.identification: A light-colored wooden crate in front of and to the left of the side gate, with light-brown bag-like bundles stacked on it in layers.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: A dilapidated brown vehicle under the low canopy on the right and behind the metal mesh.

entities.name: courtyard wall
entities.identification: A beige wall slightly right of center, with light-colored paper-like patches and dark spots on its surface and coiled wire along the top.

entities.name: arched courtyard side gate
entities.identification: A narrow arched opening behind and to the right of the stacked objects, with steps in front of the entrance.

entities.name: yellow human-shaped outline marker
entities.identification: A set of glowing yellow human-shaped outlines in the wall area on the left.

entities.name: blue trajectory line
entities.identification: A thin, translucent blue line near the side gate extending toward the top edge of the image.

entities.name: overhead power lines
entities.identification: Dark, thin cables extending diagonally and overlapping across the upper-right sky and above the canopy.

entities.name: wall-top trees
entities.identification: A collection of dark green tree crowns and yellow-green palm fronds visible behind the wall.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: Light-blue to nearly white areas of sky between the building and the tree crowns and to the image-right of the tree crowns.

entities.name: low courtyard canopy
entities.identification: A dark, low canopy above the opening on the right, with crossbeams beneath its roof and metal mesh in front of the opening.
